findings.evidence: Lines 226–228 declare `{S : Set ℂ}`, assume `hS : S ⊆ Set.range (AffineMap.lineMap ...)`, and assume differentiability on `Ω \ S`; Mathlib names the relevant set constructor `Set.range`, while `AffineMap.lineMap` itself is function-valued.
findings.fix: Rename it to expose the range/subset hypothesis, for example `differentiableOn_of_continuousOn_of_differentiableOn_diff_of_subset_range_lineMap`, and update its references.
findings.issue: `..._diff_lineMap` suggests differentiation on the complement of `AffineMap.lineMap`, which is a function; the statement instead removes an arbitrary `S ⊆ Set.range (AffineMap.lineMap ...)`. This violates the convention that underscore-separated components identify actual definitions or connectives.

summary: The arbitrary-line theorem’s name misidentifies the exceptional set as `lineMap` itself rather than a subset of its range.
